_how_it_is_used: server_scripts/grindless/uxv/shequid_mnt.js makes one recipe per entry, id grindless:<type>/<name>, with its programmed circuit (0 = none, GTM's own assembler only); 'kept' items are not consumed. shequid_assembly and multinucleon_transfer are package UXV-A6's machine types (data key = dataKey, the EMI line); assembler is GTM's (line 43's last step). Package UXV-A6, docs/eras/uxv.md machines 6-7 and process lines 18, 24 and 43.

recipes._why: line 18: the 70 nm aperture array is bonded into a titanium cell body as a weak link
recipes.name: weak_link_cell

recipes._why: line 18: two weak-link cells in a He-II bath with an MTJ die as readout; the warmed bath goes back to UV's cold works
recipes.name: shequid_gyro

recipes._why: MAX-A2 line L10 (c5): the exotic SPS billet's spin balanced in the He-II bath against the weak-link cell (kept as the gauge); the bath is consumed.
recipes.name: balanced_composite_billet

recipes._why: MAX-A2 line L41 (c7): the potted superleak's aperture flow calibrated in the He-II bath against the weak-link cell (kept as the gauge); the bath is consumed.
recipes.name: calibrated_superleak

recipes._why: MAX-B2 line L4 (c6): a SQUID-read rotation reference, the potted loop's flux calibrated in the He-II bath against the weak-link cell (kept as the gauge); the bath is consumed.
recipes.name: shequid_rotation_ref

recipes._why: machine 7 c1: a U-238 beam on a Cm-248 target near the Coulomb barrier; the target comes back spent, the recoils leave as gas
recipes.name: collision

recipes._why: machine 7 c2: the gas catcher thermalises the recoils in 6N helium; 10 mB of the buffer is lost
recipes.name: gas_catcher

recipes._why: machine 7 c3: the multi-reflection time-of-flight spectrometer sorts the ions; the light fragments leave as gas
recipes.name: mr_tof

recipes._why: machine 7 c4: sixteen island nuclides recorded on a data module make the island chart (kept by the warp gate's c10 row)
recipes.name: island_chart

recipes._why: line 43: the RF carpet board is mounted in a cryogenic cell body with foil electrodes and filled with 6N helium
recipes.name: gas_stopping_cell
